### Forever the Same
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/forever-same
Passage: Hebrews 13:8
Points:
- Believers persevere through God's preserving grace, yet difficult trials tempt them to doubt His character.
- The original recipients were wavering under persecution and needed an unchanging anchor for their faith.
- Earthly distractions and shifting cultural ideas can lead Christians toward novel, deceptive teachings.
- Because Jesus never changes in character, love, or power, believers can rely on Him unconditionally.
- Reflecting on Christ's past faithfulness builds confidence that He will sustain us today and forever.

### Faith in Finances
Author: Megan J. Conner
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/faith-in-finances-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Hebrews 13:5
Points:
- Money itself is an earthly tool, but anxiety and grasping for control expose an unhealthy posture of heart.
- Fear over material uncertainty fundamentally stems from failing to trust God as our provider.
- True freedom and contentment come from resting in the promise that God will never leave or abandon us.
- Believers find peace by intentionally surrendering specific financial worries into the Lord's hands each day.
